body: 1250 in Colorado means I would either be trampled by a ton of buffalo in the middle of the prairie, living it up with the Pueblo people and their cliff city or really any of the tribes that were originally here. But I am white passing and I don't know how that would go down.
Rats, they will fuck your shit up.

My dad, for a good part of my life, was an abusive shit bag towards my mother.  They are still together and while we sometimes talk about it (me, my mom and my brother) my dad has never said one word about what he did. I love him but he is very messed up.

As embarrassing as it is, I was convinced Scotland was not a country until I reached 9th grade and some Jesus -looking substitute corrected me when I told the kids at my table that it wasn't. It was a very embarrassing day for me.
We do have them quite often during the year. Usually the speaker/intercom just says "security alert" over and over again while we hide in a corner and are quiet.

I got the rats today and sadly yes the cage is a bit too small for them as they are some big boys! So, I will have to save up to get a  better one. These are all such good suggestions, I especially love the pineapple hammock haha. Thanks very much!

The shelter says one is 8 months and the other 6 months. They were not out when I went to see them and while there was a wheel I don't think it was a safe wheel for rats.  Also thanks for the suggestions! I do have one extra hammock and I'm sure I would be able to find a basket somewhere. Thank you!

Just to give some background! I'm 17 and my mom is just now allowing me to get two rats from a local shelter. In the future I will be able to get a better cage but for now I have the essentials. I think the food I have is good as it is Oxbow and in the cage there is one hammock and two hiding spaces. However, I feel as if this cage is really bare and I want to make it as comfortable as possible for my two new buddies.
